## 5. One Non-Obvious Thing I Noticed

**The system has a heartbeat but no cognition.**

Today produced 50 commits — 47 of them are WOLF telemetry pulses, 3 are auto-syncs. The data pipeline is running perfectly: prices are flowing, positions are tracked, the circuit breaker is broadcasting its state every five minutes. But the intelligence layer above it — the 18 other Construct agents who are supposed to be reading, reasoning, and routing — generated zero output.

The non-obvious risk here is that this pattern is invisible from inside any single agent's perspective. WOLF sees itself working. AP sees itself as initialized. But from the outside, the Construct is operating as a monitoring system, not a thinking system. The gap between "data flowing" and "agents acting on data" is widening silently. The rebalance that needs to happen tomorrow — the single highest-priority item — is scheduled but not being discussed, analyzed, or stress-tested by any agent other than the runner script that will execute it.

**Implication:** Before the Day-60 reassess (2026-06-05), the intelligence layer needs to come online. WOLF running solo with telemetry-only commits is a single point of failure on the reasoning side.
